queries: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS BytesPerMillisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaTypeName, BytesPerMillisecond, BytesPerMillisecond / NULLIF(AVG(BytesPerMillisecond) OVER (), 0) AS RelativeToAverage FROM rates;

WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS BytesPerMillisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaTypeName, BytesPerMillisecond, BytesPerMillisecond / NULLIF(AVG(BytesPerMillisecond) OVER (), 0) AS RelativeToAverage FROM rates;

WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, bytes_per_millisecond, bytes_per_millisecond / (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) FROM media_rates) AS relative_to_media_type_average FROM media_rates

assumptions.assumption: Each media type’s figure is total bytes divided by total milliseconds for tracks with known Bytes; types without such tracks are omitted.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate each media type’s figure as the simple average of its individual tracks’ bytes-per-millisecond figures.
alternatives.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS BytesPerMillisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaTypeName, BytesPerMillisecond, BytesPerMillisecond / NULLIF(AVG(BytesPerMillisecond) OVER (), 0) AS RelativeToAverage FROM rates;

assumptions.assumption: A media type's rate is total bytes divided by total milliseconds. Tracks with unknown bytes or zero duration are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type's rate is the simple average of its individual tracks' bytes-per-millisecond rates.

assumptions.assumption: A media type’s figure is total known bytes divided by total milliseconds for tracks with known Bytes. Media types are counted by MediaTypeId, even if names repeat.

alternatives.interpretation: Take the simple average of each track’s bytes-per-millisecond figure within its media type.
